details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_issue_ledger.sh:921-924 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The failure-only regex in `scan_content_line` (`line !~ /^[[:space:]]*Reviewer (slot )?[^[:space:]]+ (failed|skipped) after /`) only matches "failed after" and "skipped after". The other notices that scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh writes to reviewer output files ("skipped because", "skipped:", "failed:", "failed on", "stopped because", "failed to", "execution failed on") reset `sec_failed_only[s] = 0`, so skipped or failed slots count as live reviewers in `live_section()` and in the panel count in `prepare()`.
  WHY: Take a 3-slot panel where one slot is skipped for budget, pool unavailability or the circuit breaker. `prepare()` counts panel=3 and the rule applies with reason=applied. A lone real finding is then reclassified advisory-lone and stubbed out of the editor input, and the round can log outcome=approve. This breaks the issue's panel guard and the agents.d contract. The test `test_convergence_failed_reviewer_does_not_count_toward_panel` covers only the two matching shapes. Severity: 4 reviewers said MAJOR and google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite gave none.
- scripts/review_issue_ledger.sh:918-923 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The comment in `scan_content_line` and `agents.d/10056-review-convergence-rule.md:2` describe only the two matching shapes ("`Reviewer <model> failed after ...` / `Reviewer slot <model> skipped after ...`"). Both differ from what the production reviewer script actually emits.
  WHY: Operators and maintainers will assume the implementation covers everything scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh emits, and will not widen the regex. The reviewer calls this drift the root cause of the narrow-regex issue.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:835-872 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The TSV fallback in `render_review_rb_convergence_advisory_file` returns early when `review_convergence_advisory.txt` is absent. scripts/review_autofix_step_partial_finalize.sh (staging at lines 152-161 and 374-384) persists `review_issues.txt` and `ledger_status.txt` but not `review_convergence_advisory.txt`, so after a same-head resume the judge gets no convergence advisory notes.
  WHY: On a resumed run with `REVIEW_LEDGER_ENABLED=0`, the judge prompt's `=== BEGIN CONVERGENCE ADVISORY NOTES ===` block is empty, so a lone finding is silently dropped. This violates "It is never dropped silently". `test_review_convergence_rb_judge_notes_with_ledger_off` only covers the in-run case.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "When no blocking finding remains, the round ends as an approval: the head-gate, the security pass and final CI proceed as they do today for a clean round." (Tests: "Round 3, one lone non-security finding: the round approves")
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh (the editor-run / round decision), consuming the classification outcome from scripts/review_issue_ledger.sh (review_convergence_classify / review_convergence_log); possible consumers are scripts/review_head_gate.sh and scripts/review_final_ci_failed.sh
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: `outcome=approve` exists only as a stderr field in review_convergence_log (scripts/review_issue_ledger.sh:754-763 / 756-763 / 762-763) and nothing reads it: no status file, step output or env var carries it, and a repo-wide search finds no consumer. On an all-advisory round the editor still runs with the full reviewer_bundle.txt, which the prompt calls "authoritative" (scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:1469-1471, prompt directive at line 1505+), so approval depends on the model obeying the REVIEW CONVERGENCE directive. test_convergence_round3_lone_finding_is_advisory_and_recorded asserts only the log text. test_review_convergence_ci_gates_untouched asserts that the head gate and final CI do not reference REVIEW_CONVERGENCE. An earlier editor round marked this TASK_GAP_DEFERRED (PR comment 7147042664), but issue #10056 does not defer it.
- requirement: "A finding raised by one reviewer alone is recorded and handed to the review-blocked judge and the PR comment as a note. It is never dropped silently."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:render_review_rb_convergence_advisory_file (ledger-off branch) and the runtime artifact staging in scripts/review_autofix_step_partial_finalize.sh (lines 152-161 and 374-384) / scripts/review_autofix_step_stage_codex_logs.sh
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The staging tuples at scripts/review_autofix_step_partial_finalize.sh:152-159 and 374-383 list review_issues.txt, ledger_status.txt, floor_tags.txt, consolidator_raw.txt, parser_stats.txt, editor_summary.txt and committed_files.txt, but not review_convergence_advisory.txt. scripts/review_autofix_step_stage_codex_logs.sh stages floor_tags.txt, review_issues.txt and ledger_status.txt (line 45) but not the TSV. With REVIEW_LEDGER_ENABLED=0, the judge returns early when the TSV is absent (scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:836-840) and does not rebuild notes from the `=== ADVISORY ISSUE` stubs. The PR comment path (scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh) and the editor path (scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh) already do that rebuild. On a resume the judge stage also runs before the ledger classifier.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_issue_ledger.sh:921 (review_convergence_classify, scan_content_line; feeds live_section() lines 900-901 and the panel count in prepare() lines 985-999) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The failure-only test recognises only "failed after" and "skipped after". scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh writes other notices directly to `> "${output_file}"`:
  - budget skip, "skipped because only %ss remain" (5295-5300, 5313-5317)
  - circuit breaker, "skipped because %s." (6105)
  - pool_finish (5642) and chatgpt_finish (5893) messages: "skipped because PR ... was closed" (5669, 5910); "skipped:" (5676, 5712, 5830, 5916, 5921, 5926, 5964, 5973, 6023); "skipped because the run budget is nearly exhausted" (5816, 5941); "failed:" (5684, 5700); "failed on the Claude account pool after" (5832); "stopped because" (5813)
  scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh lines 902-923 bundle every review_*.txt without filtering by slot status.
  WHY: With MIN_REVIEWERS=2, two real reviewers and one skipped slot, panel=3 and the step logs reason=applied instead of panel_too_small. A lone finding is reclassified advisory-lone and stubbed, and the round can log outcome=approve. This breaks the issue's mitigation and the agents.d contract. Suggested fix: widen the regex to `Reviewer (slot )?[^[:space:]]+( \([^)]*\))? (failed|skipped|stopped)([[:space:]]+after|:|[[:space:]]+because|[[:space:]]+on) ` and extend test_convergence_failed_reviewer_does_not_count_toward_panel.

  Expected change site: scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh (the editor-run decision), using the classifier's blocking/advisory result from scripts/review_issue_ledger.sh
  Evidence of absence: `outcome=approve` exists only in the stderr line of review_convergence_log and nothing reads it. The editor still runs with the full reviewer_bundle.txt ("authoritative"). test_convergence_round3_lone_finding_is_advisory_and_recorded checks only the log text. Earlier rounds marked this TASK_GAP_DEFERRED, but issue #10056 does not defer it.
